svg.title: Classic block cipher modes of operation
svg.desc: Data-flow diagrams for ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB, and CTR encryption modes, showing the role of the cipher primitive, feedback, and XOR in each.

g.text: Blocks encrypt independently — identical Pᵢ ⇒ identical Cᵢ (structural leak).
Oᵢ = E(Oᵢ₋₁), Cᵢ = Pᵢ ⊕ Oᵢ, O₀ = IV
Keystream feeds forward (independent of plaintext) — encrypt = decrypt.
Counters are independent — trivially parallelisable and random-access seekable.
